Sleep loss raises risk [@hanse2013; @villette2019]. Here we show OFF periods lower tau.

# Synaptic tau falls during sleep {#sec-results}

Tau fell by half (@fig-tau) while $p < 0.05$ held, using `scipy` code.

## Dose matters

Higher doses deepened the effect (@fig-dose-b) as reported^1^ before.[^n]
